mentions.name: Mechanize-driven PDF webservice commandline client
mentions.description: This commandline tool uses Ruby's mechanize to automate access to a PDF-processing webservice that the author currently uses manually through a browser interface, handling PDF tasks such as size optimization. The author would prefer a fully local solution but depends on the webservice because it solves PDF tasks locally unavailable tools handle poorly.
mentions.problem: Local PDF tooling falls short: ghostscript produces much worse results (including size optimization), so the author relies on a webservice via a manual browser workflow and wants to automate it from the commandline.
mentions.source_excerpt:
the task for
today will be to use mechanize (in ruby) to automatically tap
into a webservice which I use manually right now via a browser
interface. I want to do this all from the commandline next.
(Ideally I'd not want to depend on this and do it locally, but
it does various things with .pdf files which I have not yet
been able to do myself.
